name: Eglumetad
summary: Eglumetad (INNTooltip International Nonproprietary Name), also known as eglumegad and by its developmental code name LY-354740, is a research drug developed by Eli Lilly and Company, which is being investigated for its potential in the treatment of anxiety and drug addiction. It is a glutamate derived compound and its mode of action implies a novel mechanism.

pharmacology.text: Eglumetad acts as a group-selective agonist for the group II metabotropic glutamate receptors (mGluR2/3). It is unclear whether eglumetad directly interacts with dopamine D2 receptors.
